content: A follow-up assessment is recommended for cured patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after treatment. Patients in the imipenem/cilastatin group exhibited higher baseline APACHE II scores, indicating a greater severity of illness at the start of the study. However, the treatment groups were otherwise generally comparable in terms of their pretreatment characteristics. Among protocol-valid patients, the overall clinical cure rate was 81% (51 cured out of 63 evaluable patients) in the cefepime plus metronidazole group, compared to 66% (62 cured out of 94 evaluable patients) in the imipenem/cilastatin group. The observed differences in efficacy may be attributed to the higher proportion of patients with elevated APACHE II scores in the imipenem/cilastatin group.
